units.rawText: Fall back! Everyone, fall back!
units.displayText: Fall back! Everyone, fall back!

spans.text: Fall back! Everyone, fall back!

units.rawText: Erwin scatters the SRA troopers with his gun while barking into his communicator.
units.displayText: Erwin scatters the SRA troopers with his gun while barking into his communicator.

spans.text: Erwin scatters the SRA troopers with his gun while barking into his communicator.

units.rawText: Doll platoon, listen to Erwin. I'll cover your retreat!
units.displayText: Doll platoon, listen to Erwin. I'll cover your retreat!

spans.text: Doll platoon, listen to Erwin. I'll cover your retreat!

units.rawText: Your body's starting to smoke, Evelyn, don't push yourself!
units.displayText: Your body's starting to smoke, Evelyn, don't push yourself!

spans.text: Your body's starting to smoke, Evelyn, don't push yourself!

units.rawText: My movement speed is reduced by 80%. I'm more suited to staying behind and protecting the rear. Right now, we need to ensure the humans' survival.
units.displayText: My movement speed is reduced by 80%. I'm more suited to staying behind and protecting the rear. Right now, we need to ensure the humans' survival.

spans.text: My movement speed is reduced by 80%. I'm more suited to staying behind and protecting the rear. Right now, we need to ensure the humans' survival.

units.rawText: ...Evelyn, look out behind you!
units.displayText: ...Evelyn, look out behind you!

spans.text: ...Evelyn, look out behind you!

units.rawText: Evelyn turns and in her already-impaired field of vision, she sees another brand new Balmung touch down.
units.displayText: Evelyn turns and in her already-impaired field of vision, she sees another brand new Balmung touch down.

spans.text: Evelyn turns and in her already-impaired field of vision, she sees another brand new Balmung touch down.

units.rawText: Run, Evelyn, run!
units.displayText: Run, Evelyn, run!

spans.text: Run, Evelyn, run!

units.rawText: Erwin shouts in her direction. Instead of continuing his retreat, he raises his gun and fires at the Balmung's joints.
units.displayText: Erwin shouts in her direction. Instead of continuing his retreat, he raises his gun and fires at the Balmung's joints.

spans.text: Erwin shouts in her direction. Instead of continuing his retreat, he raises his gun and fires at the Balmung's joints.

units.rawText: ...Erwin!
units.displayText: ...Erwin!

spans.text: ...Erwin!

units.rawText: Evelyn grits her teeth, then drags her smoking body out of the attack radius.
units.displayText: Evelyn grits her teeth, then drags her smoking body out of the attack radius.

spans.text: Evelyn grits her teeth, then drags her smoking body out of the attack radius.

units.rawText: Both humans and Dolls once again combine their firepower and rain it down on the Balmung. However, the damage they inflict in the short term can't stop it.
units.displayText: Both humans and Dolls once again combine their firepower and rain it down on the Balmung. However, the damage they inflict in the short term can't stop it.

spans.text: Both humans and Dolls once again combine their firepower and rain it down on the Balmung. However, the damage they inflict in the short term can't stop it.

units.rawText: The Balmung brings its fists down on Evelyn...
units.displayText: The Balmung brings its fists down on Evelyn...

spans.text: The Balmung brings its fists down on Evelyn...

units.rawText: A cloud of dust rises, obscuring the entire battlefield.
units.displayText: A cloud of dust rises, obscuring the entire battlefield.

spans.text: A cloud of dust rises, obscuring the entire battlefield.

units.rawText: Evelyn's eyes slowly open again.
units.displayText: Evelyn's eyes slowly open again.

spans.text: Evelyn's eyes slowly open again.

units.rawText: ...What happened? I...
units.displayText: ...What happened? I...

spans.text: ...What happened? I...

units.rawText: The Balmung is no longer moving. Its fist has smashed one of Evelyn's arms, but that's all.
units.displayText: The Balmung is no longer moving. Its fist has smashed one of Evelyn's arms, but that's all.

spans.text: The Balmung is no longer moving. Its fist has smashed one of Evelyn's arms, but that's all.

units.rawText: Evelyn looks up, and her gaze meets Python's, who is standing on the Balmung's head.
units.displayText: Evelyn looks up, and her gaze meets Python's, who is standing on the Balmung's head.

spans.text: Evelyn looks up, and her gaze meets Python's, who is standing on the Balmung's head.

units.rawText: In... Instructor?
units.displayText: In... Instructor?

spans.text: In... Instructor?

units.rawText: Python pulls his axe out of the Balmung's head armor, and amidst a shower of sparks, the Balmung completely ceases to function.
units.displayText: Python pulls his axe out of the Balmung's head armor, and amidst a shower of sparks, the Balmung completely ceases to function.

spans.text: Python pulls his axe out of the Balmung's head armor, and amidst a shower of sparks, the Balmung completely ceases to function.

units.rawText: Evelyn!
units.displayText: Evelyn!

spans.text: Evelyn!

units.rawText: Everyone hurries to drag Evelyn to safety, then they look at Python, who has suddenly made an appearance.
units.displayText: Everyone hurries to drag Evelyn to safety, then they look at Python, who has suddenly made an appearance.

spans.text: Everyone hurries to drag Evelyn to safety, then they look at Python, who has suddenly made an appearance.

units.rawText: The latter pulls a cigarette out of his pocket and lights it on the red-hot blade of his axe.
units.displayText: The latter pulls a cigarette out of his pocket and lights it on the red-hot blade of his axe.

spans.text: The latter pulls a cigarette out of his pocket and lights it on the red-hot blade of his axe.

units.rawText: He then walks decisively toward the remaining SRA troopers.
units.displayText: He then walks decisively toward the remaining SRA troopers.

spans.text: He then walks decisively toward the remaining SRA troopers.
